statements.impact_statement: Scoped to the immutable AMD64 and ARM64 manifests of quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.8.2 and only the exact OpenJDK RPM and system CA bundle PURLs listed as subcomponents. Both platform inventories show ca-certificates 2026.2.92_v9.0.319-90.3.el9_8, the RHEL 9 package in RHSA-2026:88459. Red Hat states RHEL OpenJDK relies on the system CA bundle; the original CVE-2026-91403 is the insufficient upstream Java-side blocklist, and trust-store root removal is tracked separately as CVE-2026-114406. The AMD64 JRE cacerts inspection found no compromised Comodo AAA Services or emSign ECC Root CA G3 aliases. This does not cover other tags, digests, Java builds, Red Hat build-of-OpenJDK distributions with bundled stores, or images outside these two Keycloak manifests. Evidence: CI package inventories and AMD64 trust-store check; https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-91403; https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2026-114406; https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2026:88459; https://access.redhat.com/security/vulnerabilities/RHSB-2026-012
